sources_considered.why: Original randomized trial documenting a realized operational benefit.
Read the review. Its clinical-trial sample is not a representative denominator for all publicly claimed AI benefits.
Read the laboratory announcement. One materials-development example cannot establish the proportion of promises fulfilled.

evidence_items.publisher: The Lancet Oncology, indexed by PubMed

receipt.public_excerpt: The screen-reading workload was reduced by 44·3% using AI.

evidence_items.explanation: The randomized trial documents a realized screening-workload benefit beyond personal enrichment. It establishes an exception, but does not measure how many of all claimed AI benefits remained promises.

unresolved_gaps: No representative inventory of claimed benefits and their realization was established.
The claim supplies neither a counting rule nor a threshold for 'almost every'.
The trial's benefit does not establish transformative societal benefit or improved survival.
